lines.sentence: Loki and their entourage are fended off, pushed away from the glowing light as Quilla and Straeon separate them.
HaHA! Know that the one that defeated you this time, Loki, was I! Straeon the Fearless!
Don’t get caught ahead of yourself, friend.

Indeed! Being humble is one of the hallmarks of a hero of the world! And only a hero would interrogate the villain as to their dastardly evil plot, like this! Tell us, baddie two shoes, of this mystery pendant.
The pendant…? You… don’t know of it?
Hahah…HAHAHA! ASTONISHING! Allow me a guess, you, dear Story, haven’t had time to read its story?! Or no, the stories of it were erased, weren’t they?!
Well, then allow me this, my foolish antagonist, a moment outside of my domain. A moment of honesty.

That pendant is the embodiment of change. With it in hand, a god could change the very foundation that our world sits on. Space, fate, death, even the rising of the sun and moon could all be erased or changed.
However, neither you or I are clearly strong enough to take hold of the power in it, luckily.
Why would you so clearly give that information to us? Information that is so clearly valuable to you.
Simple! Because you’re simple minded! Half of the difficulty of using it was finding it, I would dread losing it… But you’ll take it, and because of that, I will only need to find you to find it.
But why would you take it? Simple… because if you want to know its story, it itself is the only book with its tale recorded.
And with that word of promise, I will let you go. May our Strings of Life cross once more, my friends!
And then they disappear. No fight, no anger, just a silent disappearance, leaving the hof’s only residents as Quilla and Straeon.
